evaluation.limitations: Original standalone text, blank patterns, image order and explicitly linked full-size images are preserved. Cross-task navigation is inert; archive release, points and answer-checking scripts are removed. Original CSS cascade and image bytes are retained with local URL rewrites. The originally named Google Fonts families are snapshotted from their current publisher service; these binaries are not certified as the historical 2012 revisions. Contemporary font license notices accompany those dependencies, not the puzzle license. Historical place clues, fictional letters and cross-puzzle instructions are not modernized or completed with other answers. Shared-page answer variants remain distinct; scores and readiness are unchanged, not recertified. Prior limitations: The answer key exists, but the contestant puzzle page has not been separated from embedded answers and media dependencies.
